explanation: Main exits immediately after printing; goroutine may not run before program terminates.
Sleep allows goroutine to run; prints goroutine then main.
WaitGroup waits for both goroutines; order is nondeterministic but both print (1 or 2 first).
No synchronization between goroutine start and main mutex acquisition; x could be 0 or 1.
Goroutines capture i by reference; all read final i=3 after loop completes.
Passing i as argument captures its current value, but goroutine execution order is nondeterministic.
Goroutine sends 42 on c; main receives it and prints.
Mutex protects x; WaitGroup ensures all goroutines complete; x=3.
Only main goroutine is running; NumGoroutine returns 1.
Goroutines may finish before NumGoroutine is called; count is nondeterministic.
